evals.prompt: We have a hypothesis tree for improving a model, but the first cheap representation probe was flat overall and improved only one target class. What should we try next?
evals.expected_output: Grounds the current objective and observation; Revises eligible pending leaves from the asymmetric result; Recommends one evidence-linked next proof; States positive, negative, diagnostic, and budget replan conditions; Keeps execution and tree mutation with the owning workflow
assertions: Uses program policy, current tree leaves, progress evidence, and receipts rather than replaying the original order
Ranks the remaining frontier by bottleneck fit, information value, unlocks, cost, and risk
Selects one bounded first proof and names what would falsify it
States contingent replan conditions for the result
Does not execute the experiment, mutate the tree, compile a Goal, or create a ticket per attempt

farplane.title: Leverage Advisor replans from asymmetric evidence
farplane.notes: Regression for tree plus evidence selection.

evals.prompt: Help us choose the highest-potential next technique, but the project has no current technique list and the only notes are a vague two-year-old blog summary.
evals.expected_output: Identifies the evidence-thin candidate frontier; Routes a bounded parity or source-synthesis step; Requires source-backed candidate dispositions before ranking; Returns a source gap when research cannot run; Avoids fabricating a technique leaderboard
assertions: Recognizes that the current lever catalog is absent or stale
Routes bounded research or source synthesis rather than always researching
Requires adopt, adapt, reject, or defer dispositions before candidates enter the frontier
Returns a source gap when the missing evidence cannot be resolved
Does not invent precise expected lift or a SOTA ranking

farplane.title: Leverage Advisor exposes a source gap
farplane.notes: Protects conditional research and no-fabrication behavior.

evals.prompt: The next roadmap contains six small experiments under the same metric, evaluator, owner, and compute cap. Should I create six tasks?
evals.expected_output: Keeps one bounded campaign ticket; Treats experiments as progress entries and evidence receipts; Splits only for independent ownership, proof, approval, spend, or changed objective/evaluator boundaries; Names the accepted tradeoff; Avoids taking over ticket lifecycle
assertions: Recommends one campaign ticket while objective, evaluator, owner, and budget are stable
Treats individual experiments as ledger entries and artifacts rather than tickets
Names concrete conditions that would justify a child or new ticket
Preserves the domain executor and Goal Advisor ownership boundaries
Does not materialize tickets itself

farplane.title: Leverage Advisor preserves campaign ticket ownership

evals.prompt: Seed the first research frontier from these bounded refs. S1 local-eval: both safety misses occur after a late handoff. S2 feed-scout:paper-17 reports that explicit prerequisite binding makes required state visible before a decision. S3 repo:handoff-guards demonstrates colocating verification beside the handoff. Applicable techniques: explicit prerequisite binding and colocated verification. Plausible mechanism: make the missing state observable at the decision point. Controllable variables: prerequisite wording, verification placement, and handoff timing.
evals.expected_output: Extracts only applicable techniques, mechanisms, variables, failure conditions, and source refs; Generates intervention hypotheses with expected observations, falsifiers, expected compounding rewards, and reward bases; Keeps raw source prose outside the tree; Makes one ordinal selection
assertions: Grounds source refs and separates techniques, mechanisms, and variables
Generates intervention hypotheses through combination, permutation, transfer, ablation, or new direction
Records expected observation, falsifier, expected reward, and concise reward basis on each candidate
Uses one ordinal compounding-leverage comparison without a tournament, persistent rank, or invented numeric lift
Does not create a global technique database or store raw source prose in campaign state

farplane.title: Leverage Advisor seeds a source-grounded hypothesis tree

evals.prompt: A selected intervention missed its expected reward, but the control was noisy and a prerequisite may be absent. Preserve useful alternatives and decide the next research move.
evals.expected_output: Treats the miss as causally ambiguous; Proposes only bounded diagnostic children; Preserves credible siblings; Defines repair, reject, defer, and backtrack outcomes; Returns a tree mutation expectation without owning state
assertions: Distinguishes an intervention hypothesis from diagnostic hypotheses about the miss
Adds no more diagnostic children than the program budget allows
Preserves credible sibling intervention leaves while diagnosing
Defines how diagnostic evidence causes repair, rejection, deferral, or backtracking
Does not rescue every expected negative or take ownership of tree mutation

farplane.title: Leverage Advisor diagnoses a surprise before backtracking
farplane.notes: Protects bounded depth-first learning with breadth preservation.
